evidence.paraphrase: The explainer argues that a point forecast omits economically important asymmetry and tail risk contained in the full conditional distribution of future activity.
Predictors such as financial conditions are linked to several future-growth quantiles, which are then represented as a conditional probability distribution.
Examples contrast crisis and tranquil dates to show that similar central forecasts can coexist with very different downside tails and distribution shapes.
A low conditional quantile is a tail outcome rather than a recession probability; extensions to unemployment or inflation require target-specific estimation and calibration.

executive_summary: The New York Fed Outlook-at-Risk explainer changes the object of analysis from one central GDP forecast to the entire conditional distribution. Financial conditions and other predictors shift downside and upside quantiles differently, so MacroTrace must expose the tenth-percentile outcome, median, dispersion, and density calibration instead of presenting an uncalibrated recession probability.

method_routes.aggregation_role: tail-risk evidence node; only calibrated distribution probabilities may feed numerical recession-risk claims
diagnostic_requirements: rolling out-of-sample quantile and CRPS loss
method_routes.estimand: conditional quantiles and calibrated density of cumulative future GDP growth at horizon h
method_routes.formula: Q_tau(g_{t+h}|I_t)=alpha_tau+beta_tau FCI_t+gamma_tau' Macro_t; fit registered density across tau
method_routes.identification_strategy: predictive conditional distribution; coefficients are not structural causal effects of financial conditions
identifying_assumptions: forecast origins are strictly time ordered
quantile specifications are estimated without future revisions
density fitting preserves ordered quantiles and nonnegative probability
method_routes.method_family: quantile regression plus constrained conditional-density fitting
method_routes.sample_definition: real-time U.S. GDP, financial, and macro predictors available at each forecast origin

questions.question_text: How should current predictors be translated into the conditional distribution and downside tail of future U.S. growth rather than only its mean forecast?
